policy.name: Customer refund policy
policy.rule: A drink that was already served cannot be refunded, unless the wrong drink was served. Then it is replaced or refunded.
Food can be refunded within 24 hours if it is the wrong order or unsafe to eat. The customer must show the receipt.
Gift cards cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash.
An online prepaid order that was not delivered is refunded in full.
Refunds are paid back by the same method as the payment, within 5 working days.
A refund of more than 50,000 RWF needs the approval of the branch manager.
No refund is given for any order after 7 days.
